verses: (aey Muhammad salla Allah alaihi wasallam) aap keh den kay mujhay wahee ki gaee hai kay jinno ki aik jamat ney (Quran) suna aur kaha kay hum ney ajeeb Quran suna hai
Jo raah raast kay taraf rehnumaee kerta hai. Hum uss per eman laa chukay (abb) hum hergiz kissi ko bhi apney rab ka shareek na banayen gay
Aur be-shak humaray rab ki shaan bari buland hai na uss ney kissi ko (apni) biwi banaya hai na beta
Aur yeh kay hum mein ka waqoof Allah kay baray mein khilaf haq baaten kaha kerta tha
Aur hum to yehi samajhtay rahey kay na-mumkin hai kay insano aur jinnat Allah per jhooti baaten lagayen
Baat yeh hai kay chand insan baaz jinnat say panah talab kiya kertay thay jiss say jinnat apni sirkashi mein aur barh gaye
Aur (insano) ney bhi tum jinno ki tarah guman ker liya tha kay Allah kissi ko na bhejay ga (ya kissi ko doobara zindah na keray ga)
Aur hum ney aasman ko tatool ker dekha to ussay sakht chokidaron aur sakht sholon say per paya
Uss say pehlay hum baaten sunnay kay liye aasman mein jagah jagah beth jaya kertay thay. Abb jo bhi kaan lagata hai woh aik sholay ko apni taaq mein pata hai
Hum nahi jantay kay zamin walon kay sath kissi buraee ka iradah kiya gaya hai ya unn kay rab ka iradah unn kay sath bhalaee ka hai
Aur yeh kay (be-shak) baaz to hum mein neko kaar hain aur baaz uss kay bar-aks bhi hain, hum mukhtalif tareeqon say batay huye hain
Aur hum ney samajh liya kay hum Allah Taalaa ko zamin mein hergiz aajiz nahi saktay aur na hum bhaag ker ussay hara saktay hain
Hum to hidayat ki baat suntay hi uss per eman laye chukay aur jo bhi apney rab per eman laye ga ussay na kissi nuksan ka andesha hai na zulm o sitam ka
Haan hum mein baaz to musalman hain aur baaz be-insaf hain pus jo farman bardaar hogaye unhon ney to raah raast ka qasad kiya
Aur jo zalim hain woh jahannum ka endhan bann gaye
Aur (aey nabi yeh bhi keh do) kay agar log raah raast per seedhay rehtay to yaqeenan hum unhen boht waffir pani pilatay
Takay hum uss mein unhen azmalein, aur jo shakhs apney perwerdigar kay zikar say mun pher ley ga to Allah Taalaa ussay sakht azab mein mubtila kerdey ga
Aur yeh kay masjiden sirf Allah hi kay liye khaas hain pus Allah Taalaa kay sath kissi aur ko na pukaro
Aur jab Allah ka bandah uss ki ibadat kay liye khara hua to qareeb tha kay woh bheer ki bheer bann ker uss per pal paren
Aap keh dijiye kay mein to sirf apney rab hi ko pukarta hun aur uss kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi kerta
Keh dijiye kay mujhay tumharay kissi nuksan nafa ka ikhtiyar nahi
Keh dijiye kay mujhay hergiz koi Allah say bacha nahi sakta aur mein hergiz uss kay siwa koi jaye panah bhi paa nahi sakta

Albatta (mera kaam) Allah ki baat aur uss kay peghamaat(logon (logon ko) phoncha dena hai, (abb) jo bhi Allah aur uss kay rasool ki na manay ga uss kay liye jahannum ki aag hai jiss mein aisay log hamesha rahen gay
(unn ki aankh na khulay gi) yahan tak kay ussay dekh len jiss ka unn ko wada diya jata hai pus unqareeb jaan len gay kay kiss ka madadgar kamzor aur kiss ki jamat kum hai
Keh dijiye kay mujhay maloom nahi kay jiss ka wada tum say kiya jata hai woh qareeb hai ya mera rab uss kay liye door ki muddat muqarrar keray ga
Woh ghaib ka jannay wala hai aur apney ghaib per kissi ko mutlaa nahi kerta
Siwaye uss payghumbar kay jissay woh pasand kerley lekin uss kay bhi aagay peechay pehray daar muqarrar ker deta hai
Takay unn kay apney rab kay paygham phoncha denay ka ilm ho jaye Allah Taalaa ney unn kay aas pass (ki tamam cheezon) ka ehaata ker rakha hai aur her cheez ki ginti shumar ker rakha hai
